semantic.justification: The native XLSX merged-cell record consumes Calc merge anchors, including sparse empty cells, and writes the original worksheet mergeCells and mergeCell records. Legacy BIFF serialization and base XF style collection are outside the implemented XLSX merged-cell record. The OOXML SST owner counts every reference, deduplicates through XclExpString hashing and ordering, and emits xl/sharedStrings.xml with the original workbook relationship and numbered unique items. Shared strings use the actual workbook font table to serialize indexed formatted runs.
